summary: Edge multipath probe causes 5xx surge and serving runtime OOMs via KV cache pinning
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (Acme Retail, enterprise) reported a sustained increase in 5xx errors for short streaming and small-embedding requests originating from the us-east edge. Errors began ~2026-03-11 01:40 UTC and persisted with intermittent recoveries. Impact: elevated error rate (10-20% for the tenant window), failed inference calls, and downstream retries that increased load.

Observed behavior:
- API Gateway returning 502/503 to the customer for short streaming sessions and small embedding batches.
- Upstream serving runtime processes OOM-kill or crash-loop shortly after edge bursts.
- KV cache metrics show long-lived shard locks and high resident set size on a subset of runtime pods.

Expected behavior:
- Short-lived keepalive/multiplexed probes should not pin KV cache shards or escalate memory, and API Gateway should return graceful 429 or backpressure rather than widespread 5xx.

Impact:
- Customer-facing failures for Acme Retail storefront features during peak sync windows. Potential revenue impact for feature gating and degraded user experience.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) From an edge node in us-east, open ~400 concurrent short streaming connections (2-4 tokens per message) using keepalive multiplexing.
2) Interleave small embedding batch requests (size 8-16) every 10s from same IP range to simulate batch-sync behavior.
3) Observe API gateway responses and runtime pod memory/kv-lock metrics over a 5-10 minute window.
logs:
Sample logs (truncated):
[2026-03-11T01:41:12Z] apigw: conn=1972 from=54.174.x.x route=/v1/embeddings status=502 upstream=runtime-12
[2026-03-11T01:41:14Z] runtime-12: ERROR: kv_shard=45 lock_wait=23.9s resident_rss=12.5Gi OOM-kill triggered
[2026-03-11T01:41:15Z] apigw: upstream reset on runtime-12: connection closed
[2026-03-11T01:41:20Z] runtime-9: WARN: heavy-prefetch detected, pinned_keys=812 latency_ms=1200
[2026-03-11T01:42:05Z] orchestrator: restarted runtime-12 due to OOM; restart_count=3
investigation_notes:
Initial hypothesis: an edge multipath health/probe pattern combined with heavy connection multiplexing caused repeated small requests to target the same KV shards, leading to lock contention and progressive RSS growth. This produced OOMs on a small subset of serving runtime pods which upstream API Gateway then surfaced as 502/503.

What we measured:
- apigw 5xx rate for tenant window spiked from 0.3% baseline to 18% for 20m.
- Runtime pod set (runtime-9..runtime-14) showed cumulative RSS growth correlated with pinned KV entries; GC churn high but insufficient to release due to pinned references.
- Network traces show repeated CONNECT/PROBE sequences from an edge multipath probe feature that rebalanced requests across a small hot-shard set.

Hypotheses tested:
- Disabling multiplexed keepalive at edge reduced new pinned allocations (tested on canary edge) and incoming 5xx dropped to ~2.1% within 6m.
- Forcing KV shard rebalancing did not immediately free memory because pinned entries were held by in-flight streaming sessions.

Next investigative actions assigned to SRE/Runtime: heap dump analysis, kv-shard ownership timeline, and edge probe configuration audit.
comments: 2026-03-11 02:05 UTC - Support (Anika): Confirmed customer observed errors starting 01:40 UTC. Collected request IDs and tenant window. Escalating to SRE due to OOMs reported on runtime pods.
2026-03-11 02:20 UTC - SRE (Diego): Rolled a temporary routing change to avoid runtime-12; monitored memory. Noted that runtime-12 restart_count=3 and RSS hit > 12Gi before OOM. Continuing analysis.

2026-03-11 03:00 UTC - Runtime Eng (Lina): Reproduced use-case on staging with edge probe enabled. Observed KV shard lock wait >20s and inability to evict pinned entries while streaming sessions held references. Patch candidate: add soft-timeout on pin references and incremental eviction.

2026-03-11 04:10 UTC - Support (Anika): Customer acknowledged mitigation (routing change) reduced immediate errors but requests still see degraded latency. Asking for ETA on fix and recommended customer-side retries/backoff.

2026-03-12 09:30 UTC - SRE (Diego): Applied edge config change to disable multipath probes for affected PoP (canary then broad). Observed drop in 5xx to ~1.8% across tenant within 10m. Preparing coordinated runtime patch rollout.
resolution:
Mitigation applied:
- Edge operators disabled multipath probe feature for the us-east PoP (canary then full) to stop hot-shard targeting.
- Routing change removed traffic from runtime-12 and sibling pods showing OOM behavior.
- Temporary throttle guidance sent to Acme Retail to lower concurrent streaming sessions until runtime patch deploy.

Permanent fix planned: runtime team implemented a patch to make KV cache pins time-bounded and to add soft-eviction for long-held streaming references. Patch PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/8021. Rollout plan: canary on staging -> canary in us-east pool -> global during low-traffic window (ETA 2026-03-15).
follow_up_tasks: 1) Runtime: merge soft-eviction patch and schedule canary deploy (owner: Lina) - target 2026-03-14
2) SRE: add alert for rising KV pin ratio and RSS growth on small subset of pods (owner: Diego) - target 2026-03-13
3) Edge: audit multipath probe configuration and add safeguard to avoid shard-affinity (owner: Marcus) - target 2026-03-16
4) Support/CS: send post-incident summary and recommended client retry/backoff guidance to Acme Retail (owner: Anika) - target 2026-03-13
